toml:
# LEO navigation message: a message update in the middle of a pass, and whether the user
# sees a jump.
#
# A LEO pass lasts minutes, so a satellite may switch to a new message while a user is
# tracking it. At each switch the user's modelled pseudorange changes by the difference
# of the two messages' positions projected on the line of sight, minus the difference of
# their clocks. This run finds the highest pass over a user at 45 deg N, 10 deg E within
# a day, fits messages every 150 s (each over a 300 s interval centred on its
# usage period) and reports every switch in the pass: the 3D position jump, the clock
# jump, the user's range jump, the largest jump any visible user could see, and a PASS or
# FAIL against a 5 cm continuity threshold. A range-error series along the pass shows the
# message error itself around each switch. No preset; MODELLED.
kind = "leo-navmsg"
name = "LEO message mid-pass update"
seed = 13
analysis = ["midpass-update"]

[orbit]
altitude_km = 550.0
inclination_deg = 97.6
gravity_degree = 20

[message]
model = "kepler-rac"
rac_degrees = [7, 5, 6]
fit_interval_s = 300
update_period_s = 150

[midpass]
user_lat_deg = 45.0
user_lon_deg = 10.0
mask_deg = 10.0
search_s = 86400
threshold_m = 0.05
